messages:
Anya: Quick async check — mid-quarter OKR snapshot for runtime & console. Share what shipped, what slipped, and any blockers/deps (short bullets). Pls tag owners.

Jamal: Shipped: autoscale v1 -> v2 config changes (reduced median tail by ~15ms). PR 4821 merged. Canary ran at 10% yesterday :tada:

Priya: Slipped: smart model-routing for BYO customers. Integration tests failing around routing table reconcile. Root cause looks like stale cache invalidation during scale events. Owning: Priya + eng-runtime. ETA ~2w unless infra help speeds up.

Marcus: Need eng-infra to roll NLB config before we can increase canary to 50%. Raised infra ticket INF-1197. Blocking on cert rotation window. @jenna from eng-infra can you advise? 

Sarah: Product priority: routing must be ready before Dedicated ramp. If infra ETA is >1w we postpone ramp and focus on console UX polish. 

Jamal: noted. I'll throttle the dedicated ramp plan and open a canary dashboard (shared link) for visibility: https://redwood.internal/canary/4821

Priya: FYI opened a small PR that patches cache invalidation (PR 4899). Needs 1 more reviewer and a quick integration run. @Marcus or @Jamal can one of you review? 

Marcus: I can review tonight. Ping me on PR comment and I'll prioritize. 

deploy-bot: deploy-4821 to canary succeeded — 2026-03-16T21:14:02Z :white_check_mark:

Anya: Action items: 
- Priya: finish PR 4899 + wire up failing test w/ more logs (2d)
- Marcus + Jamal: review PR 4899 and approve (this week)
- Jenna/eng-infra: give cert rotation window or alternative NLB plan (preferably today)
- Sarah: hold Dedicated ramp decision pending infra note, but prep comms for customers if slip

Priya: I'll add extra logs and link a small test case in the PR description. Thanks Marcus for review offer. 

Sarah: Two asks from PM side — (1) do a short 30m codewalk tomorrow 10:00 PT for product + eng-runtime to align on routing design; (2) split the customer comms draft and share in #customer-success so we can iterate. 

Anya: 30m codewalk sounds good. Marcus / Jamal / Priya can we make 10:00 PT? If not, propose alternatives. 

Marcus: 10:00 PT works for me. 

Jamal: Works for me. 

Priya: bit tight but will make it — might join 10-20m late, will record. 

Anya: Perfect. Last ask — CR pings: PR 4899 (need 1 reviewer), PR 4902 (console UX fixes, needs QA), PR 4825 (autoscale telemetry followups). Please add yourself as reviewer where you can. :pray:

Sarah: Thanks team — short status update for OKR tracker: shipped items = autoscale config; slipped = model-routing (ETA update in 2d). I'll update the tracker after codewalk. :memo:

Marcus: I'll put a small note in the infra ticket INF-1197 about the cert window and follow up with Jenna. 

Jamal: Will keep canary dashboard updated and post a 50% bump plan once infra clears. 

Anya: great, closing this async thread — will capture notes + owners in the OKR doc. If anything urgent ping me or drop in #eng-oncall. :slightly_smiling_face:
